verdict.rationale: Filee is an offline, local desktop file converter. It documents that nothing is uploaded and files never leave the user's computer, so there is no vendor-side storage whose region could be chosen. Hosted region or residency selection is a category error for this kind of offline tool, and the evidence shows no cloud storage component that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
